newsitem.title: UK: Northern Electric bid boosts UK stock market.
newsitem.headline: Northern Electric bid boosts UK stock market.

text.p: UK shares were higher on Monday after quickly reversing slight opening losses when a bid for Northern Electric emerged to boost sentiment.
The FTSE 100 index of Britain's leading shares was up 9.6 points at 4,032.0 by 0850 GMT. Advancers outweighed gainers by roughly four-to-one.
Electricity stocks were lifted after CE Electric, a unit of CalEnergy made a 630p/shr offer for Northern Electric.
Northern Electric urged shareholders to take no action and said a further statement would be made later today. The shares rose 107-1/2p to 627-1/2p after the news.
